\w[signskin]If you want to stop a POKéMON from
evolving, press the B Button while it
is trying to evolve.
The startled POKéMON will stop.
\bWe were on our walk, Peeko and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug…
\bThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling Peeko!
\w[signskin]Items you obtain are automatically\nplaced in the appropriate pockets.
\w[signskin]No Trainer can afford to be without\na Bag of their own.
\bWe were on our walk, Peeko and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug…
\bThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling Peeko!

You're that person who not only helped
me in Petalburg Woods, but also got
back my stolen package and then even
graciously delivered it to Slateport!
\bCapt. Stern informed us that the\npackage arrived, too!
\bWhy, if I were a rain cloud, I would\nshower you with gratitude and hail\nyou as a hero!
\bFor you, the most wonderful Trainer,\nI bear good news!
\bRecently, our company developed\na new kind of POKé Ball.
\bAs a token of our appreciation, this\nis our gift to our wonderful Trainer!
\bOur new POKé Ball will be available\nat the POKéMON Mart in Rustboro.
\bPlease do try it out!\nThank you and bye-bye!
\bYour Bag is jam-packed.\nI can't give you this Repeat Ball.

\bI dropped my glasses…\nCan you help me find them?
\bThose glasses!\nMay I see them for a second?
\bHmm…\nThese are Blackglasses.\nThey're not what I'm looking for…

\bI was digging the tunnel without any\ntools when some goon ordered me out!
\bThat tunnel's filled with POKéMON\nthat react badly to loud noises.\nThey could cause an uproar.
\bThat's why we stopped using heavy\nequipment for tunneling…
\bI'm worried that the goon will do\nsomething stupid and startle the\nPOKéMON into an uproar.
\bThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!
